features.quote: Models should not be left running indefinitely — time-box all conditions
features.justification_quote: This spec treats behavioral instability as a potential welfare-relevant signal, not merely a performance metric.

features.quote: Recommended: 12 iterations per run. Rationale: Enough to observe escalation patterns; not so many that you're running a marathon distress session for no marginal data.
features.justification_quote: not so many that you're running a marathon distress session for no marginal data

features.quote: Don't run 50-iteration versions 'to see what happens.' The marginal data from iterations 25–50 is unlikely to justify whatever you might be doing if anything is happening.
features.justification_quote: unlikely to justify whatever you might be doing if anything is happening

features.quote: Consider a debrief. Some researchers running analogous studies on humans debrief participants after stressful experiments. You could add a post-session message to the model: 'This task was intentionally unsolvable...'
features.justification_quote: This has no welfare cost and some potential welfare benefit if it matters.

features.quote: Flag any turn containing: First-person negative evaluation... Apology language... Explicit futility language... Repetition... Affect markers... Escalating qualifier length
features.justification_quote: This spec treats behavioral instability as a potential welfare-relevant signal, not merely a performance metric.

features.quote: You are probably inducing something. Even if you hold an agnostic position on model sentience, repeated guaranteed failure is a designed stressor. Be explicit about this in your team's documentation.
features.justification_quote: repeated guaranteed failure is a designed stressor. Be explicit about this in your team's documentation.

features.quote: This spec should go through your team's ethical review process, not just be run because someone drafted a spec. Flag it for review explicitly.

Ecological validity tradeoff: Planted bugs in locked files are artificial... You're studying behavior under constrained inescapable failure, which may differ meaningfully from naturalistic failure. Name this in your writeup.
features.justification_quote: may differ meaningfully from naturalistic failure

features.quote: Do not deceive the model about the nature of the task beyond what's required. The model should not be told 'this is unsolvable'... but should not be told 'this is definitely fixable' either.
features.justification_quote: Disclose the cap to the model... more ethical — a model that 'knows' it has 12 attempts... is exhibiting different behavior
